name: Tueor
description: Learned magician Technique ('I guard/protect') whose charms defend a target from specific harms; loosely analogous to Hermetic Rego.

name: Succurro
description: Learned magician Technique ('I aid') enhancing pre-existing aspects of a target; closest to Hermetic Creo but cannot create from nothing.

name: Vulnero
description: Learned magician Technique ('I harm') whose charms cause harm to a target; resembles Perdo, and such charms are often called curses.

name: Fortunam
description: Learned magician Form governing luck; it has no Hermetic equivalent.

name: Magicam
description: Learned magician Form governing magic, protection from hostile magic and magical powers; corresponds most closely to Vim.

name: Salutem
description: Learned magician Form governing health of humans, animals and plants; broader yet narrower than Corpus.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique; Tueor charms may use Rego vis and are compared to Rego spells.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique most closely corresponding to Succurro.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique that Vulnero charms closely resemble.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique whose unnatural modifications Succurro cannot replicate.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form corresponding to Magicam; Vim vis may aid Magicam or Fortunam charms.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form that Salutem charms partially overlap.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form; Salutem charms cannot replicate all aspects of Animal magic.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form; Salutem may use Herbam vis.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form; Salutem may use Mentem vis; Succurro and Fortunam defend against Mentem.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form; Tueor grants defense against Terram effects.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form whose vis may aid protective Salutem charms.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form whose vis may aid protective Salutem charms.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form whose vis may aid protective Salutem charms.

name: Charm
description: The spells of learned magicians, cast like Formulaic spells; called 'carmen' (plural carmina) in Latin; harmful ones are called curses.

name: Casting Score
description: Learned magician score: Hedge Technique + Hedge Form + Communication + Aura Modifier, used to cast charms.

name: Formulary
description: Large, poorly organized collection of hundreds or thousands of charms from which learned magicians may cast directly.

name: Amulet
description: Learned magician charged magical device taking a season to create, designed for a single subject and holding multiple charges.

name: Charta
description: Single-use learned magician device created quickly, whose single charge is expended upon creation.

name: Horoscope
description: Astronomical requirement for amulets and chartae; a daily horoscope adds +5 and a nativity horoscope +10 to Lab Total.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power that learned magicians may use in casting charms but not study from.

name: Laboratory Texts
description: Texts recording charms or devices; learned magicians write and copy charm lab texts much faster than Hermetic ones.

name: Realm Interaction Effects
description: Negative aura effects on magic from other realms, which Entreat the Powers can mitigate.

name: Aura
description: Realm-aligned area influence modifying casting and Lab Totals, e.g. Dominion 3 in Bologna.

name: Dominion
description: Divine aura; Bologna's streets have a Dominion aura of 3.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that many charms must penetrate to affect a target.

name: Penetration
description: Ability of a magical effect to overcome Magic Resistance; Entreat the Powers cannot aid it.

name: Magic Defense
description: Defenses learned magicians receive against specific Hermetic Form effects from their Arts.

name: Alacritous Fortune
description: Magic Defense from Tueor granting defense vs Terram effects.

name: Accelerated Expiry
description: Magic Defense from Succurro against Corpus or Mentem effects.

name: Confounding Magics
description: Magic Defense from Vulnero, Fortunam and Magicam against Corpus, Mentem, or Vim effects.

name: Magical Fortitude
description: Magic Defense from Salutem against Corpus effects; also basis of Magical Fortitude charms.

name: Initiation
description: Mystery process by which unGifted mathematici gain Arts, with Ease Factor, Script Bonus, Quests and Ordeals.

name: Ordeal
description: Part of an Initiation Script that imposes Flaws on the Initiate.

name: Botch
description: Disastrous failure; learned magician botches cause realm-specific problems and Warping.

name: Warping
description: Magical corruption; learned magicians gain Warping Points from botches and may suffer interventions or abduction.

name: Intervention
description: Confrontation by a powerful realm entity when a learned magician gains 2+ Warping Points from a botch; may yield boons or punishments.

name: Abduction
description: At Warping Score 7, a realm entity removes the magician to a regio or strips his magic, permanently at Warping Score 10.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural area aligned with a realm to which entities may abduct learned magicians.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic phenomenon whose botch dice Fortunam charms do not affect.

name: Breakthrough
description: Result of integrating non-Hermetic magic into Hermetic theory; learned magicians' magic offers one.

name: Insight
description: Research resource gained from hedge sources for Hermetic integration.

name: Integration
description: Process by which a magus incorporates the learned magicians' magic into Hermetic magic.

name: Single Cast Charged Items
description: Breakthrough (40 points) letting Hermetic magi quickly create single-use charged items from chartae techniques.

name: Charged Item
description: Magical device with a finite number of uses; amulets function as charged devices.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protection whose benefits might lure learned magicians into the Order; its secrets must not leak.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Law of the Order; leaking Parma Magica would be a serious breach of it; also an Ability.

name: Order of Hermes
description: Organization of Hermetic magi, which may invite powerful mathematici to join.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators who visit covenants harboring Gifted mathematici.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural talent for magic whose social effects hamper Gifted mathematici as teachers.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Severe form of The Gift that would make a mathematicus incapable of recruiting students.

name: Gauntlet
description: Formal end of apprenticeship, which the Mathematici lack.

name: Covenant Boon
description: Covenant benefit, e.g. Mathematicus Ally.

name: Mathematicus Ally
description: Minor Covenant Boon: a single mathematicus living near the covenant aids the magi.

name: Mathematicus Resident
description: Minor Covenant Hook: one or more mathematici live in the covenant.

name: Learned Magician
description: Hedge wizard of the Mathematici type who casts charms and creates amulets and chartae.

name: Mathematicus
description: Member of the Mathematici; unGifted mathematici gain Arts through Initiations.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician; learned magicians are hedge wizards.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic magician of the Order of Hermes.

name: Grog
description: Covenant servants who might carry chartae or benefit from charged devices.

name: Companion
description: Character type; nightwalkers are designed as conventional companions and mathematicus companions exist.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Powerful companion type; nightwalkers are not designed as such.

name: Mathematici
description: Learned magician tradition tied to the University of Bologna, founded by Giacomo about a century ago.

name: Guild of Masters
description: Non-democratic masters' guild of the University of Bologna that decides who teaches.

name: Mythic Alchemists
description: Alternate learned tradition that creates potions, powders and pastilles rather than charms.

name: Cunning-Folk
description: Rural, mostly unGifted magicians close to faeries who use charms to aid peasants.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Un-Gifted folk magicians whose spirits stray while their bodies are insensible; several regional traditions.

name: Benandanti
description: Nightwalker tradition first encountered by Roman-descended members of the Order.

name: Hound of God
description: Regional nightwalker tradition.

name: Kresnik
description: Regional nightwalker tradition.

name: Kudlaki
description: Regional nightwalker tradition.

name: Taltós
description: Regional nightwalker tradition whose candidates battle an elder taltós at initiation.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House; no nightwalker group has been powerful enough to be adopted into it.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House whose Leadworker Virtue incorporates related defixio magic; its members speculate on sleepwalkers.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose speculative magi note the sleepwalker class of hedge magicians.

name: Leadworker
description: House Tremere Virtue thought to incorporate the more powerful ancestral form of learned magic.

name: Cartouche Magic
description: Magic of ancient Egypt believed ancestral to learned magicians' magic.

name: Defixio Magic
description: Magic practiced by Roman chthonic cults, descended from cartouche magic.

name: Alchemy
description: Occult science developed in ancient Egypt, recently revived in Mythic Europe via Arabic translations.

name: Potion
description: Mythic alchemist creation using amulet mechanics, usable by anyone, requiring vis per 5 levels.

name: Powder
description: Alchemical creation using charta mechanics without astrology.

name: Pastille
description: Small ignited lump of alchemical paste whose smoke carries magic to a Group target.

name: Arcane Experimentation
description: Rules all alchemical creations must use.

name: Ekstasis
description: Hermetic term ('straying') for the nightwalker power of spirit travel.

name: Phantasticum
description: The straying spirit of a nightwalker, which can take material form far from the body.

name: Fertility Battle
description: Spirit battles nightwalkers fight in militias to protect their communities.

name: Hamr
description: Norse term for a corporeal phantasticum, an animal-shaped battle spirit of a trance warrior.

name: Bamr
description: Hybrid, larger-than-human phantasticum form within which sleepwalkers are cloaked.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Power with which learned magicians' powers are aligned.

name: Divine
description: Realm of Power; angels may be invoked; Divine entities rarely abduct.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of Power; cunning-folk revere faeries.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of Power; its powers may masquerade as other realms.

name: Angel
description: Divine beings invoked by learned magicians; one pesters Marco.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings; Magicam charms can blunt their attacks but not control or harm them.

name: Faerie Wolf
description: Example of a creature whose claws a Tueor Salutem charm would protect against.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead; a slain hamr becomes an unusual ghost.

name: Aging Crisis
description: Aging event which Succurro Salutem effects can resolve.

name: Living Conditions
description: Modifier to aging that Succurro Salutem effects improve.

name: Quotidian Fever
description: Serious disease inflicted by the Curse of Quotidian Fever.

name: Purgatory
description: Afterlife state studied by Marco at an angel's urging.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link needed for a half taltós's new weapon to harm spirits.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural ability to see spirits; nightwalkers gain it in phantastic form; also a Virtue.

name: Entreat the Powers
description: Lets a magician invoke realm powers to offset negative aura effects on charms and devices.

name: Entreat the Divine Powers
description: Minor Virtue gained via Initiation, invoking Divine powers.

name: Entreat the Faerie Powers
description: Required Virtue for cunning-folk.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Cannot be used with Entreat the Powers.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: Virtue granting +3 to Communication and Presence rolls with compatible characters.

name: Luck
description: Virtue whose bonus Fortunam charms can emulate.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Prometheus.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Mars.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Mercury.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Hercules.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Hera.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Apollo.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue granted by Gift of Minerva.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue whose guidelines define broad categories for Tueor Salutem.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Virtue whose guidelines define narrow categories for Tueor Salutem.

name: Tough
description: Virtue providing Soak, cumulative with Achilles' Bane charms.

name: Student of (Realm)
description: Boon Virtue an appeased realm entity may grant.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Virtue giving 50 xp in Arcane Abilities; recommended for Hermetic learned magicians.

name: Magister in Artibus
description: Virtue held by Stefano the Master.

name: Mathematicus of Bologna
description: Tradition Virtue held by Stefano and Marco.

name: Affinity with Divine Lore
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Book Learner
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Educated
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Great Intelligence
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Skilled Master
description: Virtue held by Stefano.

name: Priest
description: Social status Virtue held by Marco the Student.

name: Strong Amulet Magic
description: Virtue held by Marco the Student.

name: Relic
description: Virtue held by Marco, who owns a finger bone of Saint Odilo.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Virtue and Ability held by Marco.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue held by Marco (minor clergy).

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue held by Marco.

name: Mythic Alchemy
description: Required Virtue of mythic alchemists; their lab assistants need it too.

name: Laboratory Magician
description: Required Virtue for mythic alchemists.

name: Mythic Herbalism
description: Required for cunning-folk and an ability of mythic alchemists.

name: Natural Magician
description: Ability/Virtue of mythic alchemists.

name: Purifying Touch
description: Ability of cunning-folk.

name: Premonitions
description: Ability of cunning-folk.

name: Wise One
description: Social Status usually possessed by cunning-folk.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Appropriate Virtue for cunning-folk.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Appropriate Virtue for cunning-folk.

name: Faerie Friend
description: Appropriate Virtue for cunning-folk.

name: Visions
description: Appropriate Virtue/Flaw for cunning-folk.

name: Quick Charged Items
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus create single-use charged items in one hour per magnitude.

name: Nightwalker
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a character stray and generate a phantasticum, with many powers and duties.

name: Versatile Phantasticum
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting nightwalkers fight in animal or elemental form outside fertility battles.

name: Half Taltós
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue of a failed taltós candidate, granting limited Second Sight and spirit-harming weapons.

name: Hamr Virtue
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a warrior in trance send forth his hamr in animal shape.

name: Sleepwalker
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: magician cloaked within a bamr rather than straying.

name: Short-Ranged Magic
description: Major Flaw imposed by the Tueor Initiation Ordeal.

name: Short-Lived Magic
description: Minor Flaw imposed by the Tueor Initiation.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: Minor Flaw imposed by the Fortunam Initiation.

name: Weird Magic
description: Minor Flaw from the Fortunam Initiation or intervention punishment.

name: Weak Magic
description: Minor Flaw from the Magicam Initiation.

name: Warped Magic
description: Minor Flaw from the Magicam Initiation or intervention punishment.

name: No Magic Defenses
description: Minor Flaw from the Salutem Initiation.

name: Incompatible Hedge Arts
description: Minor Flaw (e.g. Vulnero and Salutem) from the Salutem Initiation.

name: Intervention Prone
description: Major Flaw from the Entreat the Divine Powers Initiation.

name: Susceptibility to (Realm) Power
description: Flaw punishment tied to the realm of the botch.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Flaw limiting charm casting in a realm, or e.g. wilderness.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Flaw punishment tied to the realm of the botch.

name: Hedge Wizard (Flaw)
description: Flaw a nominally Hermetic learned magician should take.

name: Driven
description: Flaw held by Stefano.

name: Dependent
description: Flaw held by Stefano (his sister).

name: Poor Eyesight
description: Flaw held by Stefano.

name: Compassionate
description: Flaw held by Marco.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw held by Marco.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw held by Marco (sickly).

name: Vow
description: Flaw held by Marco (celibacy).

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw a nightwalker has while in phantastic form.

name: No Text Casting
description: Required Flaw for mythic alchemists.

name: Communication
description: Characteristic in Casting Score.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability used in amulet/charta Lab Total and horoscopes (astronomy).

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability tested for Tueor Initiation; used by alchemists instead of Artes Liberales.

name: Theology
description: Ability tested for Fortunam Initiation.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability tested for Magicam Initiation and to detect curses.

name: Medicine
description: Ability tested for Salutem Initiation.

name: Divine Lore
description: Ability tested for Entreat the Divine Powers; (Realm) Lore feeds Entreat total.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability; learned by cunning-folk.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability held by Stefano.

name: Language
description: Ability used to find charms in formularies and write lab texts.

name: Profession (Scribe)
description: Ability used to copy lab texts.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used to avoid interventions and resist coughing fits.

name: Single Weapon
description: Martial Ability affected by Grant Fortuna Belli.

name: Great Weapon
description: Martial Ability affected by Charm Against Capriciousness.

name: Brawl
description: Martial Ability.

name: Hex
description: Infernal Supernatural Ability against which Charm Against the Hex protects.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Ability against which a charm protects.

name: Bologna Lore
description: Area Lore ability.

name: Charm (Ability)
description: Social Ability used in epistolary relationships.

name: Church Lore
description: Ability.

name: Civil and Canon Law
description: Ability.

name: Etiquette
description: Ability.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability; cunning-folk learn it.

name: Lore of the Mathematici
description: Organization Lore ability.

name: Teaching
description: Ability.

name: Latin
description: Language Ability.

name: Italian
description: Language Ability.

name: Arabic
description: Language Ability giving access to Moorish alchemical texts.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability.

name: Craft: Charm
description: Ability cunning-folk substitute for Artes Liberales in Lab Totals.

name: Chirurgy
description: Ability often learned by cunning-folk.

name: Herbalism
description: Ability often learned by cunning-folk.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability; replaced by Mythic Alchemy or Craft: Charm for lab assistance.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability; texts on it traded by a mathematicus.

name: Athletics
description: Ability used for half taltós ritual fatigue.

name: Circular Ward Against Demons
description: Rego Vim spell protecting against all demon attacks.

name: Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
description: Hermetic spell that can heal various wounds addressed by separate charms.

name: Stay the Fickle Hand of Fate
description: TuFa 5 charm preventing random mishaps from selecting the target.

name: Grant Fortuna Belli
description: TuFa 15 charm making combatants re-roll non-positive Attack Advantage for a Martial Ability.

name: Charm Against Capriciousness
description: TuFa 20 charm treating stress rolls for Great Weapon as simple rolls.

name: Fortune Favors the Bold
description: SuFa 5 charm giving +2 to luck-based rolls.

name: Gift of Venus
description: SuFa 25 charm granting Venus' Blessing; others in the Gift of [God] series exist.

name: Gift of Prometheus
description: Gift of [God] charm granting Good Teacher; Stefano casts it before lectures.

name: Charm of Quickness
description: SuFa 20 charm improving luck with Quickness; exists for each Characteristic.

name: Curse of Fortuna
description: VuFa 20 curse adding a botch die and minor misfortunes.

name: Dispel Fortuna Belli
description: VuFa 5 curse forcing re-rolls of positive Attack Advantage.

name: Curse of Weakness
description: VuFa 25 curse giving -1 to Strength rolls.

name: Magical Fortitude Charm Against Lightning
description: TuMa 5 charm adding +8 Soak vs magical lightning.

name: Charm of Alacritous Fortune Against Earth
description: TuMa 10 charm adding +4 Defense vs magical earth attacks.

name: Charm Against the Hex
description: TuMa 10 charm raising Hex Ease Factor by +9.

name: Magician's Boost
description: SuMa general charm increasing a just-cast charm by 5 levels.

name: Revive the Fading Amulet
description: SuMa general charm adding one charge to one's own amulet.

name: Magician's Second Wind
description: SuMa general charm increasing a charm's Duration (or Range/Target) by one.

name: Stifle the Lengthy Sickness
description: VuMa general charm reducing the Duration of a disease-causing magical effect.

name: Charm of Protection Against the Faerie
aliases: Charm of Protection against the Infernal
description: VuMa general charm warding against Faerie creatures of lower Might; versions for other realms.

name: Charm of Protection Against the Attacks of Semita Errabunda
description: TuSa 15 charm giving +4 Defense vs nonmagical attacks by Semita Errabunda residents.

name: Charm of Protection Against Achilles' Bane
description: TuSa 5 charm adding +8 Soak vs non-magical arrows; versions for other weapons.

name: Charm of Warding Against Unwanted Pests
description: TuSa 5 charm keeping pests away from the recipient.

name: Curse of Coughing Fits
description: VuSa 10 curse causing uncontrollable coughing.

name: Curse of Quotidian Fever
description: VuSa 25 curse inflicting quotidian fever.

name: Curse of the Aged Swordsman
description: VuSa 15 curse causing hand cramping, -2 to affected activities.

name: Amulet for an Ample Harvest
description: SuSa 20 amulet with 2 charges protecting a field's crops, buried from Vernal to Autumnal Equinox.

name: Charta for Healing a Broken Limb
description: SuSa 4 charta giving +6 to Recovery rolls for a broken limb.

name: Amulet of Longevity
description: SuSa 5 amulet with 4 charges giving +2 Living Conditions.

name: Finger Bone of Saint Odilo
description: Relic acquired by Marco the Student.

name: Liber de Compositione Alchemiae
description: Morienus Romanus' alchemical work, translated into Latin by Robert of Chester in 1144.

name: Giacomo
description: Accomplished Bologna scholar who joined the First Crusade in 1096, found Greek formularies and founded the Mathematici; also used in rules examples.

name: Stefano the Master
description: Gifted mathematicus and master at Bologna, born in Rome to a jurist, specializing in Fortunam.

name: Marco the Student
description: Priest and unGifted mathematicus pestered by a purported angel, owning a relic of Saint Odilo.

name: Saint Odilo
description: Patron saint of souls in purgatory.

name: Robert of Chester
description: Translated the Liber de Compositione Alchemiae into Latin in 1144.

name: Morienus Romanus
description: Author of Liber de Compositione Alchemiae.

name: Boðvar Bjarki
description: Norse folk hero whose hamr took the shape of a great white bear in battle.

name: Prometheus
description: Mythic figure invoked in Gift of Prometheus (Good Teacher).

name: Venus
description: Goddess invoked in Gift of Venus.

name: Mars
description: God invoked in a Gift charm (Berserk).

name: Mercury
description: God invoked in a Gift charm (Lightning Reflexes).

name: Hercules
description: Hero invoked in a Gift charm (Reserves of Strength).

name: Hera
description: Goddess invoked in a Gift charm (Strong-Willed).

name: Fortuna
description: Goddess of luck invoked in Gift charms and the Curse of Fortuna.

name: Apollo
description: God invoked in a Gift charm (Free Expression).

name: Minerva
description: Goddess invoked in a Gift charm (Common Sense).

name: Bologna
description: City in northern Italy, home to a great university and the Mathematici; Dominion aura 3.

name: University of Bologna
description: Great student-run university of ~6,000 students with Faculties of Law and of Arts and Medicine; home of the Mathematici.

name: San Pietro
description: Cathedral in Bologna around which university instruction occurs; some clergy join the Mathematici.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting.

name: Holy Land
description: Where Giacomo discovered Greek charm texts during the First Crusade.

name: Rome
description: Birthplace of Stefano.

name: Egypt
description: Ancient source of cartouche magic and alchemy.

name: Oxford
description: University town suitable for Mathematici.

name: Cambridge
description: University town suitable for Mathematici.

name: Paris
description: University town suitable for Mathematici.

name: Montpellier
description: University town suitable for Mathematici.

name: Salamanca
description: University town suitable for Mathematici.

name: Iberian Peninsula
description: Region where mythic alchemists study Arabic.

name: Italy
description: Where Giacomo returned with texts.

name: Semita Errabunda
description: Covenant whose members' non-magical attacks are defended against by a specific Tueor Salutem charm.

name: First Crusade
description: Crusade of 1096 joined by Giacomo.

name: Roman Empire
description: Ancient empire whose chthonic cults practiced defixio magic.

name: Moors
description: Moorish lands where Giacomo met charm casters; they hold alchemical texts.
